title: HoloMap: First Steps
summary: Set up the first safe HoloMap loop before widening the route.

blocks.title: Start Small
blocks.body: Open the map near base, mark storage and exits, and place only the waypoint types you will actually use. Too many marks can hide urgent ones.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: A first useful map has home marked, the current route named, one danger marker, and one return path that still makes sense under pressure.

blocks.title: Before You Expand
blocks.body: Name the goal, the exit, and the resource or signal that proves HoloMap is helping. If any of those are vague, keep the next run shorter.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
